steps.title: Define the shelter
steps.instructions: Reconstructed workflow from the published prompt and available result artifacts; this is not a recorded sequence of agent turns. Use the published brief for a screw-free, flat-pack shelter with captured roof, replaceable panels and removable ballast. Keep the commercial large-format print constraint explicit.

steps.title: Model and export
steps.instructions: Create named parametric parts, assembled and exploded STEP models, individual parts and print-oriented exports. Use the existing assembled, exploded, ballast-base and roof-lock images as output references.

steps.title: Inspect and disclose limits
steps.instructions: Check solids, interfaces, entrance and part envelopes. The published result is repair-required; physical fit, stability, edges, hygiene and animal suitability remain unverified.
